title: Daniels Amazing Uranium Mod
description: This mod adds uranium, a boss named Daniel, and MUCH MUCH more! enjoy :-)
body: This mod adds new ores, bosses, weapons, portals and much more! Build sick new structures with new blocks, enjoy mining for a radio-active gemstone, or even grind to get a new overpowered weapon! This mod adds a new uranium ore only obtainable under the surface, a new forest dwelling boss with an awesome reward and even a full new set of tools and armor! Not only does this mod add an ore, it also adds a full new dimension complete with a new block called crispy salt! This mod even contains a small handcannon crafted from the new ores and materials! Enjoy!
